introHtml: Koozie camping mugs bring the rugged durability of speckled enamelware to your branded merchandise. These 16 oz mugs are built for outdoor use, with a classic campfire look that resonates with hikers, scouts, and weekend campers. Decorate them with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a durable finish that stands up to trail use. Whether you’re outfitting a corporate retreat or assembling gift sets for a summer campaign, Koozie’s speckled mugs offer a nostalgic, functional canvas that your audience will keep reaching for.
